id-20260829-news-1.title: Post-August 27 Riot in Jakarta Claims Lives, Police Investigate Alleged Mass Organization Involvement

segments.src: ## Unjuk Rasa Berujung Kericuhan
segments.tr: ## Demonstration Ends in Chaos

segments.src: Aksi unjuk rasa yang berlangsung di kawasan Gedung DPR/MPR, Jakarta, pada 27 Agustus berubah menjadi kericuhan pada malam harinya.
segments.tr: The demonstration that took place in the DPR/MPR Building area, Jakarta, on August 27 turned into chaos by the evening.

segments.src: Bentrokan antara massa dan aparat keamanan dilaporkan terjadi di beberapa titik di sekitar lokasi demonstrasi, memicu kepanikan warga dan pengguna jalan yang berada di sekitar area tersebut.
segments.tr: Clashes between the crowd and security forces were reported to have occurred at several points around the demonstration location, triggering panic among residents and road users in the surrounding area.

segments.src: Berdasarkan keterangan sementara dari pihak berwenang, kericuhan tersebut menyebabkan seorang warga meninggal dunia, sementara sejumlah orang lainnya mengalami luka-luka.
segments.tr: Based on preliminary statements from the authorities, the riot resulted in the death of one resident, while several others sustained injuries.

segments.src: Sebagian korban dilaporkan terdampak gas air mata yang digunakan aparat untuk membubarkan massa yang mulai anarkis, sementara penyebab pasti kematian korban jiwa masih dalam proses penyelidikan lebih lanjut oleh kepolisian.
segments.tr: Some of the victims were reported to have been affected by tear gas used by the authorities to disperse the crowd that began to turn anarchic, while the exact cause of death of the fatality is still under further investigation by the police.

segments.src: ## Kronologi Singkat
segments.tr: ## Brief Chronology

segments.src: Menurut sejumlah saksi mata dan rekaman yang beredar, situasi mulai memanas setelah sebagian massa yang sebelumnya berunjuk rasa secara damai berhadapan dengan barikade petugas.
segments.tr: According to a number of eyewitnesses and circulating footage, the situation began to heat up after a portion of the crowd that had previously protested peacefully faced off against officer barricades.

segments.src: Bentrokan sempat meluas ke beberapa ruas jalan protokol, menyebabkan arus lalu lintas terganggu dan sejumlah fasilitas umum mengalami kerusakan ringan.
segments.tr: The clashes briefly spread to several main thoroughfares, disrupting traffic flow and causing minor damage to a number of public facilities.

segments.src: Aparat kepolisian dan tim medis segera diturunkan untuk mengevakuasi korban serta mengendalikan situasi.
segments.tr: Police and medical teams were immediately deployed to evacuate victims and control the situation.

segments.src: Beberapa rumah sakit di sekitar Jakarta Pusat dan Jakarta Selatan dilaporkan menerima pasien dengan keluhan sesak napas dan luka akibat terjatuh atau terinjak saat massa membubarkan diri.
segments.tr: Several hospitals around Central Jakarta and South Jakarta were reported to have received patients with complaints of shortness of breath and injuries from falling or being trampled as the crowd dispersed.

segments.src: ## Polisi Dalami Dugaan Keterlibatan Ormas
segments.tr: ## Police Examine Alleged Involvement of Mass Organizations

segments.src: Polda Metro Jaya menyatakan tengah mendalami informasi mengenai dugaan keterlibatan sejumlah organisasi kemasyarakatan (ormas) dalam kericuhan tersebut.
segments.tr: Polda Metro Jaya stated that it is currently examining information regarding the alleged involvement of several mass organizations (ormas) in the riot.

segments.src: Penyelidikan ini masih berada pada tahap awal, dan pihak kepolisian menegaskan akan mengungkap hasilnya secara transparan begitu bukti-bukti telah dikumpulkan dan diverifikasi.
segments.tr: This investigation is still in its early stages, and the police have asserted that they will reveal the results transparently once evidence has been collected and verified.

segments.src: "Kami masih mengumpulkan keterangan dari berbagai pihak, termasuk saksi mata, rekaman CCTV, dan video yang beredar di masyarakat.
segments.tr: "We are still gathering statements from various parties, including eyewitnesses, CCTV footage, and videos circulating among the public.

segments.src: Semua kemungkinan masih didalami," demikian keterangan yang disampaikan oleh juru bicara Polda Metro Jaya kepada awak media.
segments.tr: All possibilities are still being investigated," said the statement delivered by the spokesperson of Polda Metro Jaya to media crews.

segments.src: Nama Gerakan Rakyat Indonesia Bersatu (GRIB Jaya) turut mengemuka dalam pemberitaan terkait dugaan tersebut.
segments.tr: The name of the United Indonesian People's Movement (GRIB Jaya) also surfaced in news reports related to the alleged involvement.

segments.src: Namun, pihak GRIB Jaya secara tegas membantah organisasinya terlibat dalam kericuhan maupun tindakan anarkis di lapangan.
segments.tr: However, GRIB Jaya firmly denied that its organization was involved in the riot or any anarchic actions on the ground.

segments.src: Perwakilan organisasi tersebut menyatakan siap bekerja sama sepenuhnya apabila diperlukan keterangan oleh pihak kepolisian, dan menegaskan bahwa tuduhan keterlibatan belum terbukti secara hukum.
segments.tr: A representative of the organization stated readiness to fully cooperate if statements are required by the police, and emphasized that the allegations of involvement have not been legally proven.

segments.src: Penting dicatat bahwa hingga saat ini belum ada pihak yang secara resmi ditetapkan sebagai tersangka terkait insiden ini.
segments.tr: It is important to note that until now no party has been officially named as a suspect in relation to this incident.

segments.src: Proses hukum masih berjalan dan publik diimbau untuk tidak menyebarkan informasi yang belum terverifikasi.
segments.tr: The legal process is still ongoing and the public is urged not to spread unverified information.

segments.src: ## Imbauan Otoritas dan Situasi Terkini
segments.tr: ## Authority Appeals and Current Situation

segments.src: Pemerintah Provinsi DKI Jakarta bersama aparat keamanan mengimbau masyarakat untuk tetap tenang dan menahan diri dari menyebarkan spekulasi maupun berita yang belum terkonfirmasi kebenarannya.
segments.tr: The Provincial Government of DKI Jakarta together with security forces appealed to the public to remain calm and refrain from spreading speculation or unconfirmed news.

segments.src: Beberapa ruas jalan di sekitar kawasan Gedung DPR sempat ditutup sementara untuk kepentingan penyelidikan dan pemulihan situasi keamanan.
segments.tr: Several roads around the DPR Building area were temporarily closed for the purpose of investigation and the restoration of the security situation.

segments.src: Otoritas terkait juga menyampaikan belasungkawa kepada keluarga korban yang meninggal dunia dan memastikan seluruh biaya perawatan korban luka-luka ditanggung sesuai prosedur yang berlaku.
segments.tr: The relevant authorities also expressed condolences to the families of the deceased victims and ensured that all treatment costs for injured victims are covered in accordance with applicable procedures.

segments.src: Investigasi menyeluruh dijanjikan akan dilakukan secara independen untuk memastikan akuntabilitas seluruh pihak yang terlibat, baik dari sisi aparat maupun massa aksi.
segments.tr: A thorough investigation is promised to be conducted independently to ensure the accountability of all parties involved, both from the side of the authorities and the protest crowd.

segments.src: Hingga berita ini diturunkan, situasi di sekitar kawasan Gedung DPR dilaporkan berangsur kondusif, meski pengamanan masih diperketat sebagai antisipasi terjadinya eskalasi susulan.
segments.tr: Until this news was published, the situation around the DPR Building area was reported to be gradually conducive, although security remains tightened in anticipation of secondary escalation.

segments.src: Masyarakat diimbau untuk terus memantau informasi resmi dari kepolisian dan pemerintah daerah terkait perkembangan penyelidikan kasus ini.
segments.tr: The public is urged to continue monitoring official information from the police and local government regarding the progress of this case investigation.

id-20260829-news-2.title: Purbaya Reveals Import Tax Leakage on Steel and Building Materials Exceeds IDR 10 Trillion

segments.src: Menteri Keuangan Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa mengungkapkan temuan mengenai kebocoran penerimaan pajak dari sektor impor baja dan bahan bangunan yang diperkirakan mencapai lebih dari Rp10 triliun.
segments.tr: Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa revealed findings regarding tax revenue leakage from the imported steel and building materials sector, which is estimated to reach more than IDR 10 trillion.

segments.src: Pernyataan ini disampaikan sebagai bagian dari upaya pemerintah memperkuat pengawasan arus barang impor sekaligus menjaga daya saing produk dalam negeri.
segments.tr: This statement was delivered as part of the government's efforts to strengthen supervision of imported goods flows while maintaining the competitiveness of domestic products.

segments.src: ## Temuan Kebocoran Pajak
segments.tr: ## Tax Leakage Findings

segments.src: Menurut Purbaya, potensi kebocoran tersebut diduga terjadi akibat sejumlah celah dalam proses administrasi dan pengawasan impor komoditas baja serta material konstruksi lainnya.
segments.tr: According to Purbaya, this potential leakage is suspected to occur due to a number of loopholes in the administration and supervision process of steel commodity imports and other construction materials.

segments.src: Ia menyebut bahwa nilai kebocoran yang teridentifikasi sejauh ini sudah menembus angka Rp10 triliun, dan kementerian akan terus mendalami cakupan persoalan tersebut agar penanganannya dapat dilakukan secara menyeluruh.
segments.tr: He mentioned that the value of the leakage identified so far has exceeded the figure of IDR 10 trillion, and the ministry will continue to examine the scope of the issue so that handling can be carried out comprehensively.

segments.src: Kementerian Keuangan menegaskan bahwa temuan ini menjadi salah satu prioritas dalam agenda pembenahan sistem penerimaan negara, mengingat sektor baja dan bahan bangunan merupakan salah satu kontributor penting dalam rantai pasok industri konstruksi maupun manufaktur nasional.
segments.tr: The Ministry of Finance emphasized that this finding is one of the priorities in the state revenue system improvement agenda, considering that the steel and building materials sector is an important contributor to the national construction and manufacturing industry supply chain.

segments.src: ## Target Penyelesaian pada 2027
segments.tr: ## Resolution Target by 2027

segments.src: Purbaya menyampaikan bahwa pemerintah menargetkan persoalan kebocoran pajak di sektor ini dapat dituntaskan pada 2027.
segments.tr: Purbaya stated that the government targets the tax leakage issue in this sector to be resolved by 2027.

segments.src: Target waktu tersebut disusun dengan mempertimbangkan kompleksitas proses audit, pembenahan tata kelola impor, serta koordinasi lintas lembaga yang dibutuhkan untuk menutup celah-celah yang selama ini dimanfaatkan oleh pihak tertentu.
segments.tr: This time target was formulated by considering the complexity of the audit process, improvements in import governance, and cross-institutional coordination needed to close the loopholes that have been exploited by certain parties.

segments.src: Langkah ini juga sejalan dengan agenda besar reformasi perpajakan yang tengah didorong pemerintah, termasuk penguatan sistem pengawasan berbasis data serta sinergi antara otoritas pajak dan bea cukai dalam memantau arus barang impor.
segments.tr: This step is also in line with the major tax reform agenda being promoted by the government, including strengthening data-based supervision systems and synergy between tax and customs authorities in monitoring the flow of imported goods.

segments.src: ## Dampak terhadap Industri Lokal
segments.tr: ## Impact on Local Industry

segments.src: Purbaya menekankan bahwa penanganan kebocoran pajak impor baja dan bahan bangunan tidak hanya berdampak pada penerimaan negara, tetapi juga berkaitan erat dengan upaya menjaga daya saing produsen lokal.
segments.tr: Purbaya emphasized that handling import tax leakage on steel and building materials not only impacts state revenue, but is also closely related to efforts to maintain the competitiveness of local producers.

segments.src: Praktik impor yang tidak tercatat secara akurat berpotensi menciptakan persaingan usaha yang tidak sehat, di mana produk impor dapat dijual dengan harga lebih murah dibandingkan produk dalam negeri yang telah memenuhi kewajiban pajak secara penuh.
segments.tr: Import practices that are not accurately recorded have the potential to create unfair business competition, where imported products can be sold at lower prices compared to domestic products that have fully fulfilled their tax obligations.

segments.src: Dengan menutup celah tersebut, pemerintah berharap industri baja dan bahan bangunan nasional dapat bersaing secara lebih adil, sekaligus mendorong pertumbuhan investasi di sektor manufaktur dalam negeri.
segments.tr: By closing these loopholes, the government hopes that the national steel and building materials industry can compete more fairly, while encouraging investment growth in the domestic manufacturing sector.

segments.src: ## Langkah Lanjutan Pemerintah
segments.tr: ## Further Government Steps

segments.src: Ke depan, Kementerian Keuangan disebut akan memperkuat koordinasi dengan instansi terkait, termasuk Direktorat Jenderal Bea dan Cukai serta Direktorat Jenderal Pajak, guna memastikan proses verifikasi importir berjalan lebih ketat.
segments.tr: Going forward, the Ministry of Finance is said to strengthen coordination with related agencies, including the Directorate General of Customs and Excise and the Directorate General of Taxes, to ensure the importer verification process runs more strictly.

segments.src: Evaluasi terhadap regulasi impor komoditas strategis seperti baja juga disebut akan menjadi bagian dari langkah pembenahan jangka menengah pemerintah.
segments.tr: Evaluations of import regulations for strategic commodities such as steel are also said to be part of the government's medium-term improvement steps.

segments.src: Purbaya menyatakan optimismenya bahwa dengan pengawasan yang lebih baik, target penerimaan negara dapat tercapai tanpa membebani pelaku usaha yang taat aturan, sekaligus memberi ruang yang lebih sehat bagi pertumbuhan industri dalam negeri.
segments.tr: Purbaya expressed his optimism that with better supervision, state revenue targets can be achieved without burdening law-abiding business actors, while providing a healthier space for domestic industry growth.

id-20260829-news-3.title: Prabowo Cabinet Reshuffle Issue Intensifies Following Vacant Imipas Deputy Minister and Deputy Minister of Agriculture Seats

segments.src: Spekulasi mengenai kemungkinan perombakan atau reshuffle Kabinet Merah Putih kembali menghangat di kalangan pengamat politik dan publik.
segments.tr: Speculation regarding the possibility of a reshuffle of the Red and White Cabinet has heated up once again among political observers and the public.

segments.src: Pemicunya adalah kekosongan dua kursi wakil menteri sekaligus, yaitu Wakil Menteri Imigrasi dan Pemasyarakatan (Wamen Imipas) serta Wakil Menteri Pertanian (Wamentan), yang terjadi hampir bersamaan dalam beberapa waktu terakhir.
segments.tr: The trigger is the vacancy of two deputy minister seats simultaneously, namely the Deputy Minister of Immigration and Corrections (Imipas Deputy Minister) and the Deputy Minister of Agriculture (Wamentan), which occurred almost concurrently recently.

segments.src: ## Kursi Wamen Imipas Kosong Usai Sorotan KPK
segments.tr: ## Imipas Deputy Minister Seat Vacant Following KPK Spotlight

segments.src: Kursi Wamen Imipas menjadi lowong setelah nama Silmy Karim ramai diberitakan terkait proses yang tengah berjalan di Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi (KPK).
segments.tr: The Imipas Deputy Minister seat became vacant after Silmy Karim's name was widely reported in connection with an ongoing process at the Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK).

segments.src: Perlu digarisbawahi bahwa hingga saat ini proses hukum terkait yang bersangkutan masih berjalan, dan publik diimbau menunggu keterangan resmi dari KPK serta pihak-pihak terkait sebelum menarik kesimpulan.
segments.tr: It should be underlined that until now the legal process concerning the individual is still ongoing, and the public is urged to wait for official statements from the KPK and related parties before drawing conclusions.

segments.src: Media massa nasional turut memantau perkembangan kasus ini, mengingat posisi Wamen Imipas memiliki peran strategis dalam pengawasan lalu lintas orang serta pembinaan sistem pemasyarakatan di Indonesia.
segments.tr: The national mass media is also monitoring the development of this case, considering that the position of Imipas Deputy Minister has a strategic role in supervising the traffic of people and fostering the correctional system in Indonesia.

segments.src: Kekosongan pada posisi strategis ini otomatis memunculkan pertanyaan mengenai siapa sosok yang akan mengisi jabatan tersebut, dan apakah pengisian kursi ini akan dilakukan melalui mekanisme reshuffle terbatas atau sekadar pergantian pejabat setingkat wakil menteri tanpa menyentuh pos menteri lainnya.
segments.tr: The vacancy in this strategic position automatically raises questions about who will fill the position, and whether the filling of this seat will be carried out through a limited reshuffle mechanism or simply a change of officials at the deputy minister level without touching other minister posts.

segments.src: ## Wamentan Bergeser ke Badan Gizi Nasional
segments.tr: ## Deputy Minister of Agriculture Shifts to National Food Agency

segments.src: Di sisi lain, kursi Wakil Menteri Pertanian juga mengalami kekosongan setelah pejabat yang sebelumnya menempati posisi tersebut ditugaskan untuk memperkuat jajaran Badan Gizi Nasional (BGN).
segments.tr: On the other hand, the seat of the Deputy Minister of Agriculture is also vacant after the official who previously occupied the position was assigned to strengthen the ranks of the National Food Agency (BGN).

segments.src: Perpindahan ini dinilai wajar mengingat BGN merupakan salah satu lembaga prioritas pemerintahan Prabowo Subianto dalam menjalankan program strategis di bidang gizi dan ketahanan pangan nasional, sehingga membutuhkan tambahan sumber daya manusia yang berpengalaman di sektor terkait pertanian dan pangan.
segments.tr: This transfer is considered natural considering that BGN is one of Prabowo Subianto's government priority institutions in carrying out strategic programs in the field of food nutrition and national security, thus requiring additional human resources experienced in the related agricultural and food sectors.

segments.src: Meski demikian, publik tetap menyoroti bahwa kekosongan di Kementerian Pertanian perlu segera diisi agar roda birokrasi dan program kerja kementerian tidak terganggu, terutama di tengah agenda besar pemerintah untuk memperkuat swasembada pangan.
segments.tr: Even so, the public still highlights that the vacancy in the Ministry of Agriculture needs to be filled immediately so that the wheels of bureaucracy and ministry work programs are not disrupted, especially in the midst of the government's major agenda to strengthen food self-sufficiency.

segments.src: ## Spekulasi Reshuffle kian Menguat
segments.tr: ## Reshuffle Speculation Intensifies

segments.src: Bersamaan dengan dua kekosongan tersebut, sejumlah pengamat politik menilai momentum ini berpotensi menjadi pintu masuk bagi Presiden Prabowo Subianto untuk melakukan evaluasi menyeluruh terhadap kinerja kabinet, tidak menutup kemungkinan turut menyentuh pos-pos kementerian lain yang dinilai perlu penyegaran.
segments.tr: Along with the two vacancies, a number of political observers assess that this momentum has the potential to become an entry point for President Prabowo Subianto to conduct a comprehensive evaluation of cabinet performance, not ruling out the possibility of touching other ministerial posts deemed in need of refreshment.

segments.src: Analisis semacam ini merupakan bagian dari dinamika politik yang lumrah setiap kali terjadi kekosongan jabatan strategis di lingkaran pemerintahan.
segments.tr: Analysis of this kind is part of the common political dynamics every time there is a vacancy of strategic positions in the government circle.

segments.src: Sejumlah nama pun mulai beredar di ruang publik sebagai kandidat potensial pengganti, meski hingga kini belum ada konfirmasi resmi dari Istana maupun partai-partai koalisi pendukung pemerintah mengenai sosok yang akan diusulkan.
segments.tr: A number of names have also begun to circulate in the public space as potential replacement candidates, although until now there has been no official confirmation from the Palace or political parties supporting the government regarding the figures to be proposed.

segments.src: ## Istana: Belum Ada Kepastian Waktu
segments.tr: ## Palace: No Certainty of Time

segments.src: Menanggapi berbagai spekulasi yang beredar, pihak Istana Kepresidenan menegaskan bahwa hingga saat ini belum ada keputusan resmi maupun jadwal pasti terkait reshuffle kabinet.
segments.tr: Responding to various speculations circulating, the Presidential Palace emphasized that until now there has been no official decision or exact schedule regarding the cabinet reshuffle.

segments.src: Juru bicara kepresidenan menyampaikan bahwa pengisian jabatan yang kosong merupakan hak prerogatif penuh Presiden, dan segala keputusan akan diumumkan melalui saluran resmi apabila sudah final.
segments.tr: The presidential spokesperson stated that filling vacant positions is the full prerogative of the President, and all decisions will be announced through official channels once finalized.

segments.src: Pernyataan ini sekaligus menjadi imbauan agar masyarakat tidak mudah terpengaruh oleh spekulasi maupun informasi yang belum terverifikasi, dan senantiasa merujuk pada pengumuman resmi dari Istana atau Kementerian Sekretariat Negara terkait perkembangan susunan kabinet ke depan.
segments.tr: This statement is also an appeal for the public not to be easily influenced by speculations or unverified information, and to always refer to official announcements from the Palace or the Ministry of State Secretariat regarding future cabinet composition developments.

segments.src: ## Menanti Langkah Presiden Prabowo
segments.tr: ## Awaiting President Prabowo's Steps

segments.src: Dengan dua kursi wakil menteri yang kini kosong, publik menanti langkah selanjutnya dari Presiden Prabowo Subianto dalam menata ulang jajaran kabinetnya.
segments.tr: With two deputy minister seats now vacant, the public awaits the next step from President Prabowo Subianto in rearranging his cabinet ranks.

segments.src: Apakah pengisian kekosongan ini akan bersifat terbatas atau justru menjadi awal dari reshuffle yang lebih luas, semuanya masih akan bergantung pada pertimbangan politik dan kebutuhan pemerintahan yang hanya diketahui secara pasti oleh Presiden dan lingkaran terdekatnya.
segments.tr: Whether filling this vacancy will be limited or even the beginning of a wider reshuffle, everything will still depend on political considerations and government needs that are only known for sure by the President and his inner circle.

segments.src: Yang jelas, dinamika ini menunjukkan bahwa proses konsolidasi pemerintahan terus berjalan, dan publik diharapkan tetap mengedepankan sikap kritis namun berimbang dalam menyikapi setiap perkembangan informasi seputar kabinet pemerintahan.
segments.tr: What is clear is that this dynamic shows that the government consolidation process continues to run, and the public is expected to continue to prioritize a critical yet balanced attitude in responding to every information development surrounding the government cabinet.

id-20260829-intro-agriculture-10.title: [Agronomy #10] Greenhouses: When Farmers Control the Weather from Indoors

segments.src: > Hortikultura terlindung (greenhouse) mengubah petani dari "penerima cuaca" menjadi "pengatur cuaca": suhu, air, dan nutrisi dikontrol agar tanaman tumbuh optimal sepanjang tahun.
segments.tr: > Protected horticulture (greenhouse) transforms farmers from "weather recipients" into "weather controllers": temperature, water, and nutrients are controlled so that plants grow optimally throughout the year.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Concept of the Day

segments.src: Bayangkan Anda ingin menanam tomat atau selada di musim yang seharusnya terlalu panas, terlalu hujan, atau terlalu banyak hama.
segments.tr: Imagine you want to grow tomatoes or lettuce in a season that should be too hot, too rainy, or too full of pests.

segments.src: Di lapangan terbuka, Anda hanya bisa pasrah pada cuaca.
segments.tr: In an open field, you can only surrender to the weather.

segments.src: **Hortikultura terlindung** (protected cultivation) menyelesaikan masalah ini: tanaman ditanam di dalam sebuah struktur pelindung, sehingga lingkungannya bisa diatur.
segments.tr: **Protected horticulture** (protected cultivation) solves this problem: plants are grown inside a protective structure, so their environment can be regulated.

segments.src: Ada tiga pilar yang perlu Anda pahami:
segments.tr: There are three pillars you need to understand:

segments.src: 1. **Struktur rumah kaca (greenhouse/screen house).** Rangka yang ditutup kaca, plastik UV, atau jaring (screen). Fungsinya menahan hujan berlebih, mengurangi serangan hama, dan memerangkap sebagian panas matahari agar suhu di dalam stabil. Di daerah tropis seperti Indonesia, yang lebih sering dipakai adalah *screen house* atau rumah plastik dengan ventilasi lebar, karena tantangannya justru mengurangi panas dan kelembapan, bukan menambah panas.
segments.tr: 1. **Greenhouse/screen house structure.** A frame covered with glass, UV plastic, or netting (screen). Its function is to withstand excessive rain, reduce pest attacks, and trap some solar heat so that the temperature inside is stable. In tropical regions like Indonesia, what is more often used is a *screen house* or plastic house with wide ventilation, because the challenge is actually reducing heat and humidity, not adding heat.

segments.src: 2. **Hidroponik (soilless culture / kultur tanpa tanah).** Tanaman ditanam tanpa tanah; akarnya menyerap air yang sudah dicampur nutrisi. Contoh sistemnya: *NFT* (aliran tipis larutan lewat talang), *rakit apung* (akar mengambang di kolam nutrisi), dan *drip* (tetesan ke media seperti rockwool atau cocopeat). Keuntungannya: hemat air, bersih dari hama tanah, dan pertumbuhan lebih cepat karena nutrisi selalu tersedia.
segments.tr: 2. **Hydroponics (soilless culture).** Plants are grown without soil; their roots absorb water that has been mixed with nutrients. Examples of systems: *NFT* (thin film of solution flowing through gutters), *floating raft* (roots floating in a nutrient pond), and *drip* (drops onto media like rockwool or cocopeat). The advantages: water-saving, clean from soil pests, and faster growth because nutrients are always available.

segments.src: 3. **Kontrol lingkungan.** Ini "otak"-nya. Petani memantau dan mengatur suhu, kelembapan, cahaya, CO2, serta kepekatan dan keasaman larutan nutrisi. Dua angka yang paling sering diucapkan petani hidroponik:
segments.tr: 3. **Environmental control.** This is the "brain." Farmers monitor and regulate temperature, humidity, light, CO2, as well as the concentration and acidity of the nutrient solution. Two numbers most often spoken by hydroponic farmers:

segments.src: - **EC** (Electrical Conductivity) → menunjukkan seberapa pekat nutrisi dalam air.
segments.tr: - **EC** (Electrical Conductivity) → indicates how concentrated the nutrients are in the water.

segments.src: - **pH** → menunjukkan seberapa asam/basa larutan; kalau meleset, akar sulit menyerap unsur hara meski nutrisinya ada.
segments.tr: - **pH** → indicates how acidic/alkaline the solution is; if it's off, roots struggle to absorb nutrients even if they are present.

segments.src: Intinya: rumah kaca menyediakan "ruangannya", hidroponik menyediakan "cara makannya", dan kontrol lingkungan menyediakan "aturannya".
segments.tr: The point is: the greenhouse provides the "room," hydroponics provides the "way of eating," and environmental control provides the "rules."

segments.src: ## Di Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Naiklah ke dataran tinggi Lembang di utara Bandung, atau ke kawasan Cianjur dan Batu (Malang).
segments.tr: Go up to the Lembang highlands north of Bandung, or to the Cianjur and Batu (Malang) areas.

segments.src: Di sana banyak berdiri rumah plastik dan *screen house* penghasil selada, tomat ceri, dan paprika.
segments.tr: There, many plastic houses and *screen houses* stand, producing lettuce, cherry tomatoes, and bell peppers.

segments.src: Seorang petani milenial di Lembang, misalnya, menanam selada hidroponik sistem NFT.
segments.tr: A millennial farmer in Lembang, for example, grows hydroponic lettuce using an NFT system.

segments.src: Setiap pagi ia tidak menyiram dengan selang, tapi mengecek layar: EC larutan sekitar 1,2–1,8 mS/cm dan pH sekitar 5,5–6,5.
segments.tr: Every morning, he doesn't water with a hose, but checks the screen: the solution EC is around 1.2–1.8 mS/cm and the pH is around 5.5–6.5.

segments.src: Kalau siang terlalu panas, jaring peneduh (*paranet*) menutup otomatis dan kipas menyala.
segments.tr: If the afternoon is too hot, the shading net (*paranet*) closes automatically and the fans turn on.

segments.src: Hasilnya terasa di pasar: selada dari rumah kaca ini bisa dijual Rp 25.000–40.000 per kilogram ke supermarket dan kafe di Jakarta, jauh di atas selada lapangan biasa, karena bersih, renyah, dan pasokannya stabil sepanjang tahun, tidak putus saat musim hujan.
segments.tr: The result is felt in the market: lettuce from these greenhouses can be sold for Rp 25,000–40,000 per kilogram to supermarkets and cafes in Jakarta, far above regular field lettuce, because it is clean, crunchy, and the supply is stable throughout the year, not cut off during the rainy season.

segments.src: Bagi konsumen kota, inilah alasan selada dalam kemasan plastik di rak swalayan selalu ada, tidak peduli sedang kemarau atau hujan deras.
segments.tr: For city consumers, this is the reason why lettuce in plastic packaging on supermarket shelves is always available, regardless of whether it is the dry season or heavy rain.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Hortikultura terlindung memindahkan pertanian ke dalam struktur (rumah kaca, rumah plastik, *screen house*) agar lingkungan bisa diatur.
segments.tr: 1. Protected horticulture moves farming into structures (greenhouses, plastic houses, *screen houses*) so that the environment can be regulated.

segments.src: 2. Hidroponik menanam tanpa tanah dan memberi makan tanaman lewat larutan nutrisi (NFT, rakit apung, drip), sehingga hemat air dan cepat panen.
segments.tr: 2. Hydroponics grows plants without soil and feeds them via nutrient solutions (NFT, floating raft, drip), saving water and speeding up harvest.

segments.src: 3. Kontrol lingkungan mengatur suhu, kelembapan, cahaya, serta EC dan pH nutrisi supaya panen stabil dan berkualitas sepanjang tahun.
segments.tr: 3. Environmental control regulates temperature, humidity, light, as well as nutrient EC and pH so that harvests are stable and high-quality throughout the year.

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Terminology of the Day

segments.src: - **Hortikultura terlindung (protected cultivation):** budidaya tanaman di dalam struktur pelindung agar lingkungan bisa dikendalikan.
segments.tr: - **Protected horticulture (protected cultivation):** plant cultivation inside protective structures so the environment can be controlled.

segments.src: - **Hidroponik:** teknik menanam tanpa tanah, memberi nutrisi lewat larutan air.
segments.tr: - **Hydroponics:** a technique of growing without soil, providing nutrients via water solution.

segments.src: - **NFT (Nutrient Film Technique):** sistem hidroponik dengan aliran tipis larutan nutrisi yang terus mengalir melewati akar.
segments.tr: - **NFT (Nutrient Film Technique):** a hydroponic system with a thin flow of nutrient solution that continuously flows past the roots.

segments.src: - **EC (Electrical Conductivity):** ukuran kepekatan nutrisi dalam larutan, satuannya mS/cm.
segments.tr: - **EC (Electrical Conductivity):** a measure of nutrient concentration in a solution, measured in mS/cm.

segments.src: - **pH:** ukuran tingkat keasaman larutan yang menentukan mudah-tidaknya akar menyerap unsur hara.
segments.tr: - **pH:** a measure of the acidity level of a solution that determines how easily roots can absorb nutrients.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) b — di tropis, ventilasi dan peneduh untuk membuang panas serta kelembapan lebih penting daripada memerangkap panas.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) b — in the tropics, ventilation and shading to remove heat and humidity are more important than trapping heat.

segments.src: 2) Benar — EC memang menggambarkan kepekatan nutrisi; makin tinggi EC, makin pekat larutannya.
segments.tr: 2) True — EC does describe nutrient concentration; the higher the EC, the more concentrated the solution.

segments.src: 3) b — pada rakit apung, akar mengambang di kolam nutrisi, berbeda dari NFT (aliran tipis) dan drip (tetesan).*
segments.tr: 3) b — in a floating raft, roots float in a nutrient pond, different from NFT (thin flow) and drip (drops).*
